design.processName: Job-work subcontracting: heat-numbered forged blanks from Chakan through external heat treatment and shot blasting, receipt at Chakan or Bhosari, vendor settlement and job-work statutory reporting

keyDesignDecisions.topic: Where the stock lying at the six job-workers is held and aged

options.name: Vendor-held stock as a special stock per vendor, part and heat
options.pros: Stock stays company-owned in a named place, is aged from the issue date and relieves automatically on return against the original challan.
options.cons: Needs careful control of the vendor stock balances; a return posted outside it leaves the balance open.

options.name: Vendor location treated as an ordinary storage location
options.pros: Simple to set up, no special stock categories.
options.cons: Cannot tell our own plant stock from material sitting at a vendor, and gives no ageing per vendor.

options.name: Manage stock at the vendor in a side system and reconcile monthly
options.pros: No change to the core stock model.
options.cons: Leaves the audit-qualified unreconciled position in place and duplicates data.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Vendor-held stock as a special stock per vendor, part and heat
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: R-17 and R-20 need heat on every movement and the audit finding (R-13, INR 3.2 crore) needs stock attributable to a named vendor and ageing date; standard special stock at a vendor delivers both without custom code, whereas an ordinary storage location cannot separate our stock from the vendor's. The parallel Tally run for the LLP and the direct Bhosari path, where in whose books the material sits is still open, are cited as the questions this choice must still clear: pending JWK-OQ-2 and IQ-14. Budget of INR 2.5 crore rules out a side system.

keyDesignDecisions.topic: Whether negative stock on issue to job-workers is allowed, and for which scope

options.name: Block negative stock; the forging order is posted before the issue
options.pros: Stock and heat-number balances are always true, so vendor stock and traceability reports can be trusted.
options.cons: Contradicts the MD's stated wish and asks stores to complete the forging confirmation first, which is a work habit change.

options.name: Allow negative stock for job-work issues only, at plant Chakan 2100, for a transition period
options.pros: Keeps the MD's Tally-like freedom where it is asked for and limits the damage to one plant and one movement.
options.cons: A negative balance breaks the ageing-by-heat picture and must be cleared before each month-end close; who may post it has to be agreed.

options.name: Temporary posting authorisation for a named role with automatic alert to the plant head
options.pros: The exception is visible and auditable instead of silent.
options.cons: Extra authorisation to maintain; still leaves negative balances that must be cleaned.

options.name: Side-by-side exception app that releases the issue outside the core
options.pros: Keeps the core free of exceptions.
options.cons: Another integration to run and monitor, and the stock still ends up negative.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Allow negative stock for job-work issues only, at plant Chakan 2100, for a transition period
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: The MD's constraint is explicit and cannot be ignored, but a blanket setting would defeat the heat traceability target (100%) and the unreconciled-stock target (zero). This decision is not taken: which plant and company-code combinations may post negative, and how the setting must behave while the LLP keeps Tally running in parallel, is open, so every option stands until pending JWK-OQ-1 and IQ-17 are answered.

fitGap.justification: Vendor-held stock as a subcontracting stock balance per vendor, part and heat is configured master data and stock setup, so issues and returns derive the balance; no custom code is needed. Not STANDARD because the 6 vendors, their storage locations and the stock determination must be set up here.
fitGap.validationReason: No verified SAP catalog available; consultant must confirm the subcontracting stock and stock-at-vendor reporting capability for this release.

fitGap.justification: A system-generated job-work challan replaces the manual triplicate and the ITC-04 data is read from those documents, so setup of the challan document type and the return report is configuration. A custom ITC-04 form would be the cleaner-class escape only if the standard output is insufficient.
fitGap.validationReason: Confirm whether the standard statutory job-work challan and ITC-04 return cover the GST format, or a key-user report is required.

masterDataPrerequisites.object: Job-worker vendor master (6 heat-treatment and shot-blasting vendors) with MSME attributes
keyFields: vendor account group for subcontracted service vendors
masterDataPrerequisites.migrationSource: Tally vendor master and the Excel job-work register, to be confirmed by the business
masterDataPrerequisites.creationChannel: Created in the vendor master by the accounts team; no app is named in the design, so the creation path needs validation.
masterDataPrerequisites.governance: Plant Head Chakan approves a new or changed job-worker; a duplicate GSTIN or a missing MSME category blocks the record, since payment-limit control depends on it.

masterDataPrerequisites.object: Forged blank material master with heat-number batch management
keyFields: heat-number characteristic as a mandatory batch field
masterDataPrerequisites.migrationSource: Tally item master plus the annual Excel cost sheet, to be confirmed by the business
masterDataPrerequisites.creationChannel: Created at cutover from the Tally item list; new parts are added by the stores and planning team before the forging order is raised.
masterDataPrerequisites.governance: A material cannot be released without batch management and the mandatory heat field; a new heat number is created only from the forging lot and duplicates are blocked by the batch key.

dataMigration.object: Job-worker vendor masters and MSME attributes
dataMigration.source: Tally vendor master and the Excel job-work register
dataMigration.approach: Cleanse the 6 job-workers, de-duplicate by GSTIN, add MSME category and job-work indicator, load, then reconcile the count against the register.
dataMigration.risk: A wrong MSME flag pays a vendor outside the 45-day limit; accounts spot-checks each record.

dataMigration.object: Material master for forged blanks and purchased steel with heat-number batch setup
dataMigration.source: Tally item master and the annual Excel cost sheet
dataMigration.approach: Cleanse part numbers and units, set batch management and the mandatory heat field, load, then reconcile to Tally item count.
dataMigration.risk: Parts created without batch management cannot carry a heat number; the load is rejected until every job-worked part is corrected.

cutover.activity: Freeze job-work issues and returns at Chakan for the migration window and take a physical count with each of the 6 job-workers, split by part and heat.
cutover.risk: Blanks in transit on the freeze date belong to no balance; the truck log is captured on paper and keyed against its challan after go-live. Go-live date is 1 April 2027 from the timeline.

cutover.activity: Load vendor masters, material masters and the agreed opening stock at each job-worker by part, heat and challan, in that order.
cutover.risk: An opening balance that disagrees with the vendor's confirmation restarts the audit qualification; each vendor signs off its balance before the load is released.

periodEndActivities.activity: Reconcile the vendor-held stock of each of the 6 job-workers to the open challans and the vendor's confirmation, and clear the differences before the period is closed.
Post the rejections scrapped at the job-workers for the month against their challans and heat numbers, with quality approval, so the pieces are relieved from vendor-held stock before the close.

interfaces.counterpartSystem: GST IRP and e-way bill portal via a GSP
interfaces.triggerFrequency: Event: each time a system job-work challan is posted in JWK-2-1 and each time a dispatch is made in JWK-7-1; volume follows roughly 70% of about 900 tonnes a month going out to 6 job-workers
interfaces.payload: Challan and invoice details needed for the GST e-way bill on job-work movements and for e-invoicing on customer invoices
interfaces.validationReason: No verified catalog for this release; confirm which GST service provider interface is certified for e-way bills generated from job-work challans.

failureHandling.detection: A rejected e-way bill or e-invoice response from the GST service provider shows in the interface error list against the challan or billing document.
failureHandling.alerting: The Accounts Executive receives the rejection with the provider's reason and the document number.
failureHandling.rerun: The Accounts Executive corrects the master data or document, resends that one document from the same challan or invoice and confirms the portal number is stored.
failureHandling.idempotency: The document number and GST document number are held on the challan or invoice; a resend for a document that already carries a portal number is stopped.

interfaces.systemOfRecord: SAP for the challan and the invoice; the GST portal holds the government-issued e-way bill and invoice reference number

interfaces.triggerFrequency: Per period; scope and cut-off still pending IQ-17 and IQ-27
interfaces.payload: Job-work challans issued and returns and scrapped quantities relieved for the Chakan LLP plant, so the LLP books kept in Tally still show material movements
interfaces.validationReason: No catalog reference; and the parallel-run arrangement, cut-off and whether the LLP may post from Tally at all are undecided (pending IQ-17).

failureHandling.detection: A period extract that Tally does not accept shows in the interface error list with the challan numbers it contains.
failureHandling.alerting: The Accounts Executive is told which challan numbers failed so the LLP books are not left behind.
failureHandling.rerun: Corrected challan data is extracted again for the affected challans only and reloaded into Tally.
failureHandling.idempotency: Each extract carries a period and challan reference; Tally rejects a challan number it already holds.

interfaces.systemOfRecord: SAP for the job-work stock and challans; the LLP books remain in Tally during the parallel run

kpis.baseline: not provided — current value to be measured by Plant Head Chakan from today's records before go-live

kpis.validationReason: No catalog reference; confirm the report that evidences vendor-held stock in this release.

kpis.baseline: not provided — current value to be measured by Plant Head Chakan from today's records before go-live
kpis.measuredFrom: Heat traceability report over receipts and inspection lots
kpis.validationReason: No catalog reference; confirm the batch and heat traceability report available in this release.

objectives.statement: Reconcile every kilogram of forged blank lying with the six job-workers so no material at a vendor is unaccounted for at period end.
Give Tata and Hyundai parts full heat-number traceability from forging through heat treatment and shot blasting to machining receipt.

scopeStatements.statement: Job-work issue, gate clearance, receipt at Chakan or Bhosari, scrap at the vendor, per-kg invoice match, MSME payment and ITC-04 reporting for the six heat treatment and shot blasting job-workers.
scopeStatements.reason: The stated process scope runs from Chakan forging to the treated blanks arriving at Chakan or Bhosari, and every step of that chain is in this design.

scopeStatements.statement: Heat-numbered forging at Chakan and the inbound customer schedules that generate job-work demand, in company codes 2000 (Chakan) and 1000 (Bhosari).
scopeStatements.reason: Issued lots must carry a heat number, so forging with heat identification and the schedules that drive it are inside the flow; the unit codes come from the stated org units.

orgStructure.proposal: Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, holding Bhosari, Hosur and the Chennai warehouse.
Shaktiman Forge LLP, holding the Chakan forging plant where the blanks are issued to job-workers.

reports.name: Stock at vendor by part and heat (stock lying with each of the 6 job-workers)
reports.purpose: Lets the Plant Head Chakan and the Chakan accounts team see what quantity of which part and heat sits at each job-worker, per challan and issue date, so the INR 3.2 crore unreconciled stock cannot build up again.
reports.realization: Standard stock-at-vendor evaluation of the vendor-held subcontracting stock per challan, part and heat. Proposed, to be validated by the Plant Head Chakan; no verified catalogue reference exists for this release.
reports.validationReason: Confirm the standard stock-at-vendor evaluation reports material at a subcontractor per challan, part and heat in this release.

reports.name: Job-work ageing alert for material at job-workers (150-day warning before the GST one-year limit)
reports.purpose: Shows the Plant Head Chakan and the CFO every open challan quantity by days at the vendor, flagging anything past 150 days so the GST one-year return deadline is never missed.
reports.realization: Standard ageing evaluation of open subcontracting challan quantities. Proposed, to be validated by the CFO; the 150-day threshold is a client control, not a standard figure.
reports.validationReason: Confirm an ageing evaluation on open job-work challan quantities with an alert at 150 days is available without custom development.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Heat-numbered forged blanks from Chakan forging through job-work heat treatment back to Chakan receipt and vendor settlement
endToEndTests.given: A forging lot of 5,000 gear blanks at Chakan (plant 2100) carries heat number H-2027-041; 3,500 blanks are issued to one heat-treatment job-worker on a system challan and the rest stay at Chakan.
endToEndTests.when: The forging lot is planned and forged, the store keeper issues the 3,500 blanks on a system challan by part and heat, the gate clears the truck, the vendor returns 1,500 blanks and 500 crack-rejected pieces, and the monthly per-kg invoice is matched.
endToEndTests.then: Stock-at-vendor shows 1,500 blanks at that job-worker under heat H-2027-041, the 500 rejected pieces are on record against the same challan and heat, the returns relieve vendor stock to Chakan, and the invoice is payable only for the returned quantity and weight; pending JWK-OQ-3 on the kg-versus-pieces basis and JWK-OQ-4 on the treatment of scrap.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Direct delivery of a treated lot from the job-worker to Bhosari and the ITC-04 return
endToEndTests.given: A second heat H-2027-042 with 2,000 crankshaft blanks is issued on a Chakan challan, and the job-worker delivers the treated blanks straight to Bhosari (company code 1000) instead of back to Chakan.
endToEndTests.when: Bhosari receives and inspects the lot against the original Chakan challan with a mandatory heat number, the inter-company movement is posted, and the quarter is closed with the ITC-04 extract.
endToEndTests.then: The Chakan challan is closed by the Bhosari receipt, the heat is traceable into Bhosari supply, the material no longer sits at the vendor, and the ITC-04 statement shows issued and returned quantities per challan; pending JWK-OQ-2 on whose books hold the material and how the cross-entity return is reported.

roles.name: Master data administrator
roles.responsibilities: Creates and maintains job-worker, part, heat and vendor-held stock master data.

roles.name: Plant Head Chakan
roles.responsibilities: Process owner; approves the issue release, parked job-work invoices and reviews 150-day ageing alerts.

sodAssessments.description: The Chakan store keeper creates and posts the job-work challan and the same role receives returns at Chakan, so an issue could be hidden by a matching receipt.
sodAssessments.mitigation: The separate Plant head role releases each challan before issue and the Chakan production supervisor reviews the stock-at-vendor ageing report each period; who releases remains pending IQ-26.

sodAssessments.description: Chakan accounts both performs the three-way match on the job-work invoice and releases the payment proposal for the same vendor.
sodAssessments.mitigation: The invoice is blocked until the match is complete and Plant Head Chakan records approval in the system before the payment proposal includes it.

controlMappings.realization: A system job-work challan is mandatory for the issue and the quarterly ITC-04 dataset is generated only from posted challans and returns.
A receipt cannot be posted without a heat number, so traceability is enforced at the point the lot changes hands.

steps.title: Set up job-worker master data, heat identification and vendor-held stock
steps.trigger: The go-live readiness work for Chakan (company code 2000, Shaktiman Forge LLP) and Bhosari (company code 1000, Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd) starts ahead of the 1 April 2027 go-live, and the six heat treatment and shot blasting job-workers are to be created in SAP before the first issuing step (JWK-2-1) runs.
steps.interimProcess: Nothing exists in SAP before go-live: the Chakan store keeper keeps issuing blanks on manual challans and finance keeps the Excel ITC-04 register until this set-up is finished, and the LLP continues its parallel Tally run with no retirement date agreed.
inputDocuments: Signed job-work contract of each heat treatment and shot blasting job-worker (per-kg processing charge basis, GSTIN and MSME registration particulars)
GST registration particulars of Shaktiman Forge LLP (company code 2000) and Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd (company code 1000)
Forged blank part list from Chakan with part numbers, weights and the Hyundai and Tata parts flagged for heat traceability
Heat number list of forged lots produced at Chakan plant 2100
List of the storage locations used at Chakan and Bhosari (raw material, work in progress, finished goods, quality hold, scrap)
The manual delivery challan and the Excel ITC-04 register kept today, read only to copy the job-worker list and challan numbering in use
outputDocuments: Supplier master records for the 6 job-workers in company codes 1000 and 2000 with MSME attributes and the per-kg processing charge basis
Heat number identification entered against the forged blank batches or serials for plant 2100
Vendor-held stock reference for each job-worker and company code, created with the job-work issue in this flow
Part master records of the forged blanks with the heat traceability flag for Tata and Hyundai parts
Master data sign-off sheet listing every job-worker, part, heat and storage location set up

actions.operation: Create one supplier record per job-worker in company code 2000 and in company code 1000, taken from the signed contract and GST registration particulars.

Record each job-worker's MSME status from its registration certificate so that the statutory payment limit can be applied by the paying step, and leave the payment term as the input the buying role confirms.
fields: payment terms (to be confirmed by the buying role)

actions.operation: Set up each forged blank as a part with the identification that carries the heat number, so that a heat can be recorded on every issue and every receipt.
fields: unit of measure (pieces) and weight (kg) per piece
heat traceability flag for Tata and Hyundai parts

actions.operation: Record the per-kg processing charge basis agreed in the contract on the purchasing information record of the job-worker and part, for use when the monthly invoice is matched.

Assign each job-worker the vendor-held stock reference to be used on the job-work issue, and confirm in whose books the stock at the job-worker will sit for the direct-to-Bhosari case; the assignment is confirmed only when that ownership question is answered.
fields: ownership of stock at the job-worker (held)

actions.operation: Confirm the storage location used for raw blanks at Chakan plant 2100 and at Bhosari, and confirm whether quality hold and scrap need their own storage locations in each plant.
Enter the heat numbers of the forged lots against the batches or serials of the blank parts so that a heat can be selected at issue.
Review the six supplier records, MSME attributes, charge bases, heat identification and storage locations and sign the set-up off as complete for go-live.

exceptions.condition: A job-worker cannot produce a GSTIN or an MSME registration certificate
exceptions.response: The supplier record is created with the particulars available and MSME status marked unknown, and the gap is listed on the sign-off sheet for the Plant Head Chakan to close before the first issue; no MSME payment limit is applied to that vendor until the status is known.

exceptions.condition: The same heat number appears on two different parts or two forged lots
exceptions.response: The setup is rejected and returned to the forging plant, which must confirm the correct heat number; no part is released for issue with a duplicated heat number.

exceptions.condition: The business has not named the storage location for raw blanks, quality hold or scrap at one of the plants
exceptions.response: The affected location is left unconfigured, the setup of that plant is marked incomplete on the sign-off sheet, and no goods movement is set up against a location name the business has not confirmed.

masterData.object: Job-worker supplier record (heat treatment and shot blasting vendor)

fields: unit of measure (pieces) and weight per piece (kg)
heat traceability flag for Tata and Hyundai parts

masterData.object: Job-work processing charge basis on the purchasing information record
Vendor-held stock reference for material at the job-worker
fields: ownership of stock at the job-worker (held)

masterData.object: Storage location master for plant 2100 Chakan and Bhosari

effects.inventory: No stock is moved and no stock exists at a job-worker because of this step; it creates the master data with which the job-work issue (JWK-2-1) opens vendor-held stock per job-worker and company code and the receipts (JWK-3-1, JWK-3-2) relieve it.
effects.financial: No cost, revenue or vendor liability arises in this step. The supplier records created here make the later job-work invoices payable and the MSME attributes make the statutory payment limit applicable in JWK-5-2.
effects.ownership: Blank material remains owned by the company that issued it; this step records that owning company code on each job-worker record. Whether the stock at the job-worker belongs to Shaktiman Forge LLP or Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd for a lot sent directly to Bhosari is not decided here and is held pending JWK-OQ-2.
effects.accountingEntry: None: this step only creates supplier, part, heat and storage-location master data and posts no goods movement or invoice, so no accounting document is created.

steps.addedValue: The six job-workers, their MSME status, the per-kg charge basis and every forged heat number exist in the system before the first truck leaves Chakan, which is the precondition for replacing the Excel challan tracker and the INR 3.2 crore of unreconciled material at vendors with a stock balance per job-worker and heat.

businessRules.condition: A job-worker from the six heat treatment and shot blasting vendors is created
businessRules.response: It is created in both company code 2000 (Chakan, Shaktiman Forge LLP) and company code 1000 (Bhosari, Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd), because treated lots can come back to either plant.

Saving is blocked unless GSTIN and MSME registration particulars are entered; a job-worker whose certificate is not produced stays with MSME status unknown and is reported to the Plant Head Chakan, who must obtain it before go-live.

businessRules.condition: A forged blank part is created or changed
businessRules.response: Heat-number identification is mandatory on the part; for a part flagged as a Tata or Hyundai part the heat traceability flag is set so that a receipt without a heat number is refused at receiving.

businessRules.condition: A job-work issue is prepared for a job-worker
businessRules.response: The vendor-held stock reference assigned in this step must exist for the pair of job-worker and company code shipping the material; where it is missing the issue cannot be started. For the direct-to-Bhosari case the assignment is held pending JWK-OQ-2, which must decide in whose books the material sits while it is at the vendor.

businessRules.condition: The heat numbers of a forged lot are entered against a part
businessRules.response: The heat number is recorded once per forged lot with its part and quantity, and is never re-used for a different lot; a correction is made by a new heat number entry and the old one is marked, not deleted, so that issued heat history stays intact.

businessRules.condition: A storage location is needed for a blank, a quality hold or scrap at Chakan or Bhosari
businessRules.response: Only a location whose name is confirmed by the business is used; where the business has not named it the location is left to be provided and the initial stock and goods movements of this flow are not configured against it.

businessRules.condition: The set-up is reviewed before go-live
businessRules.response: The Plant Head Chakan signs it off only when all six job-workers exist in both company codes, every Tata and Hyundai part carries the heat traceability flag and the storage locations of both plants are confirmed; the six vendor-held records of stock at the job-workers are opened by the issues in this flow, not by this step, so a signed-off set-up does not yet prove material is at a vendor.

businessRules.condition: The set-up is complete and the parallel Tally run of the LLP continues
businessRules.response: No job-worker, part or heat record is maintained twice: SAP is the record for job-work from go-live, and the retirement date of the LLP's parallel Tally run is held pending the business decision on that date and is not assumed by this step.

businessRules.condition: The question of who releases a job-work issue in the system and whether the gate check stays as a compensating control is still open
businessRules.response: This step only creates the roles' access to supplier, part and heat data; it does not grant an issue release. The release authority used at issuing (Plant Head Chakan for the first period) and the retention of the gate check remain held pending JWK-OQ-5.

implementation.detail: No SAP reference is available for this release, so the whole set-up is unverified: supplier master with GSTIN and MSME attributes in two company codes, blank part master with batch or serial identification and a heat traceability flag, heat number entry per forged lot, per-kg charge basis on the purchasing information record, and vendor-held stock for job-work issues. Validation points: confirm that the release supports per-kg job-work charge conditions, that a receipt can be blocked for a missing heat number, and that the vendor-held stock can be assigned per job-worker and company code as required by JWK-OQ-2.

acceptanceTests.given: The six heat treatment and shot blasting job-workers with signed contracts and GSTIN and MSME certificates, the forged blank part list with Tata and Hyundai parts flagged, the heat number list of the forged lots and the confirmed storage locations of Chakan plant 2100 and Bhosari
acceptanceTests.when: The Master data administrator creates the six supplier records in company codes 1000 and 2000, the blank parts with heat traceability flags, the heat numbers against each forged lot and the per-kg charge basis, and the Plant Head Chakan signs the set-up off
acceptanceTests.then: Six job-workers exist in both company codes with MSME status and charge basis, every Tata and Hyundai part carries the heat traceability flag, each forged lot shows its heat number, and the sign-off sheet lists the storage locations used at both plants with no item open.

acceptanceTests.given: One of the six job-workers has not supplied its MSME registration certificate, and the business has not named the quality hold storage location at Bhosari
acceptanceTests.when: The Master data administrator saves that supplier record and completes the sign-off sheet
acceptanceTests.then: The supplier is saved with MSME status marked unknown and listed for follow-up, the Bhosari quality hold location is left unconfigured and marked incomplete, and the Plant Head Chakan cannot sign off until both are closed; no payment limit and no goods movement is set up on the unconfirmed data.

acceptanceTests.given: A forged lot appears twice with the same heat number on two different blank parts
acceptanceTests.when: The Master data administrator enters the heat numbers and the Plant Head Chakan reviews them
acceptanceTests.then: The duplicate is rejected and returned to the forging plant for confirmation, the affected part is not released for issue, and the supplier and part set-up otherwise stays complete.

steps.title: Take customer schedules and call-offs in through the customer portals
steps.trigger: A customer schedule arrives: a monthly delivery schedule from Tata (SupplierNet), Mahindra or Hyundai (portal or email) or a quarterly purchase order with a weekly call-off from the German Tier-1 by email.
inputDocuments: Monthly delivery schedule from Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal or email as received today
Quarterly purchase order with weekly call-off from the German Tier-1, received by email
Customer master record with the customer and ship-to partner numbers used by each portal
Material master record keyed to each customer part number
Interface specification agreed with each customer portal (message type, frequency, part-number mapping)
outputDocuments: Scheduling agreement with schedule lines per customer part and date, referencing the customer schedule
Inbound interface message log record per schedule or call-off receipt (received, accepted, rejected)
Exception list of schedule lines or part numbers that could not be assigned

actions.operation: Register the customer's portal access and confirm with the portal administrator that this company's plant is an authorised recipient; the receiving plant is stated by the portal account and is not chosen in SAP.
fields: receiving plant configured for the account

actions.operation: Create or maintain one scheduling agreement per customer and customer part, with the customer part number mapped to the material number, so incoming schedule lines have a fixed target.
Send the monthly delivery schedule or weekly call-off to SAP at the agreed frequency; the message carries customer, customer part number, quantity and requested delivery date.
Validate each incoming message against the customer master, the material-to-customer-part mapping and the open scheduling agreement, then post the schedule lines into the agreement.
Write one log record for every received message and every rejected message or schedule line, with the reason, so the same message identifier is not posted twice.
Work the daily exception list: correct master data and re-submit the corrected message, or ask the customer to resend; a schedule line is never re-keyed by hand into a second record.

For a customer still sending by email, save the schedule or call-off as an attachment on the scheduling agreement and enter the same schedule lines with the customer document number, until the portal link is available for that customer.

exceptions.condition: A customer part number in a schedule line has no material mapping or no open scheduling agreement for the requested date
exceptions.response: The line is rejected and logged with the customer part number and reason; the sales coordinator creates the mapping or the agreement and re-submits the line; the remaining lines of the message stay posted.

exceptions.condition: The portal link or its receiving service fails, or the customer says a message was sent that SAP never logged
exceptions.response: Deliveries received but not accepted are held and reported; after a check with the customer on the message identifier, the same message is reposted once; if it was in fact posted, the duplicate receipt is shown and nothing is posted again.

exceptions.condition: The same message arrives twice with the same message identifier
exceptions.response: The second receipt is marked as a duplicate and no schedule lines are added; the sales coordinator informs the customer only if the resent quantities differ from the posted ones.

exceptions.condition: A customer issues a revised or reduced schedule after the earlier quantities were already used by the planners
exceptions.response: The revision replaces the affected schedule line quantities; the sales coordinator reports the already-consumed quantity for that part to the Plant Head Chakan, who decides the consequence together with the Bhosari planner outside this step; who bears such a reduction is not stated in the sources and is held pending IQ-6 and JWK-OQ-3 only insofar as it affects the quantity basis.

masterData.object: Material master and customer-material information record

effects.inventory: None: this step only records customer demand as schedule lines; no stock is moved, reserved or valuated, and no goods movement is created.
effects.financial: None: accepting a schedule or call-off creates no invoice, no receivable and no revenue; it only makes the demand available to planning in the next step.
effects.ownership: No change: material and blanks remain with the company that holds them; the customer's schedule creates no ownership or custody transfer.
effects.accountingEntry: None: no goods or services are supplied and no invoice is created in this step, so no accounting document is posted.

steps.addedValue: Each monthly schedule and weekly call-off lands once, as schedule lines against the right customer part and plant, in the same system the planners use, so the re-keying into Tally and the separate Excel tracker disappear and planning starts from the customer's own quantities.

businessRules.condition: A schedule or call-off arrives through a customer portal link
businessRules.response: Post it directly as schedule lines on the customer's scheduling agreement for the receiving plant; the sales coordinator does not re-key it into another system or spreadsheet, and no parallel tracker is maintained.

businessRules.condition: A schedule line names a customer part number that is not mapped to a material, or whose scheduling agreement is closed or not yet valid for that date
businessRules.response: Reject only that line, log it with the reason on the exception list and leave every other line of the message posted; the sales coordinator completes the mapping or the agreement and re-submits the corrected line under the same customer reference.

businessRules.condition: A message identifier that has already been posted arrives again (customer resend, network retry)
businessRules.response: Do not post a second set of schedule lines; show the earlier posting result and mark the message as a duplicate receipt.

businessRules.condition: The customer sends a revised schedule that replaces earlier quantities for the same dates
businessRules.response: The schedule line quantities of the scheduling agreement are updated (replaced) for the affected dates, and the earlier and the revised quantity are both visible in the agreement history; nothing is added as a fresh demand on top.

businessRules.condition: The customer withdraws or cancels a schedule or call-off line
businessRules.response: Reduce or delete the corresponding schedule line quantities in the scheduling agreement before the affected step consumes them, so the withdrawn quantity cannot be passed on as job-work or forging demand.

businessRules.condition: A customer (the German Tier-1) sends a purchase order with weekly call-offs instead of a delivery schedule
businessRules.response: Post the purchase order as the scheduling agreement header and each call-off as schedule lines referencing the customer order number, so both receipts remain traceable to the customer document.

businessRules.condition: The portal link or the receiving service is unavailable for a customer
businessRules.response: Retain the unposted message, record the delivery failure with the message identifier, alert the sales coordinator, and repost the same message once the link is back; the message identifier prevents a duplicate when the customer resends.

businessRules.condition: A customer is still sending schedules by email rather than through a portal link
businessRules.response: The sales coordinator enters the schedule lines manually with the customer document number and attaches the email, and that customer moves to the portal link only when the interface is agreed with that customer; the manual path exists for named customers only, pending IQ-4 and IQ-5 confirming the current receipt and re-keying steps.

businessRules.condition: This step is performed for Chakan (company code 2000) and Bhosari (company code 1000) only; Hosur is not included
businessRules.response: Schedule lines are posted only for plants in those two company codes; whether Hosur stays outside this process is held pending JWK-OQ-8, and no Hosur schedule is posted until that decision.

businessRules.condition: A schedule line quantity would be posted at a plant that the portal account does not designate
businessRules.response: Reject the line and log it; the receiving plant is never reassigned by hand to make a message post.

implementation.detail: No verified SAP catalogue was supplied for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702, so the object choice must be confirmed by a consultant. Proposed: post customer portal schedules and call-offs as schedule lines on a scheduling agreement in SAP sales, with the customer part number held in the customer-material information record and the duplicate check on the customer message identifier. Interface technology (portal EDI/API adapter, certificate and monitoring), whether supplier scheduling inbound is supported for each customer's message format, and the receiving-plant configuration are validation points; any extension for exception logging is not yet evidenced.

acceptanceTests.given: A scheduling agreement exists for Tata, customer part number CP-4471 mapped to a material, for Chakan, and a monthly delivery schedule message arrives through the portal link with three schedule lines
acceptanceTests.when: The interface validates and posts the message
acceptanceTests.then: The scheduling agreement shows the three schedule lines with the customer's quantities and requested dates, one log record for the message shows accepted, and no second record or spreadsheet entry exists for the same quantities.

acceptanceTests.given: A quarterly purchase order with a weekly call-off arrives by email from the German Tier-1
acceptanceTests.when: The sales coordinator posts the order as the scheduling agreement header and the call-off as schedule lines and attaches the email
acceptanceTests.then: The agreement references the customer purchase order number and shows the call-off quantities with the requested dates; both documents are visible on the agreement.

acceptanceTests.given: A message with three schedule lines arrives and one line names a customer part number with no material mapping
acceptanceTests.then: The two mapped lines are posted to the scheduling agreement, the unmapped line is rejected and appears on the exception list with the customer part number and reason, and the sales coordinator re-submits that line after creating the mapping.

acceptanceTests.given: A message with message identifier M-900 was already posted and the customer resends it with the same identifier
acceptanceTests.when: The interface receives the second message
acceptanceTests.then: The receipt is logged as a duplicate, the scheduling agreement keeps the first set of schedule lines only, and no additional demand exists.

eliminatedAsIsSteps.reason: Machining, Hosur assembly and warehouse shipping execution lie beyond the job-work boundary, which ends with the posted receipt at Chakan or Bhosari; only the receipt hand-off into machining supply is designed.

The hand-keyed sales invoice between GSTINs covering job-work material is replaced by the inter-company posting of the direct Bhosari receipt; other inter-plant invoicing is outside this job-work design.

coverage.rationale: Every issue and return moves stock through a challan, so the quantity lying with each vendor is derived from documents and the reconciliation statement is built from it.
A system job-work challan replaces the manual triplicate challan, and the quarterly ITC-04 data is generated from the same documents instead of an Excel register.
